title: The Breaker
text: "We've talked about this for a long time. Longer than you know." {who} has a hand on a breaker someone has wired into the Core's feed: crude work, and careful. "We built it the year the turret turned. We hoped we'd never need it."

lines.speaker: {who}
lines.text: "I don't think you're lying. I think you can't know. That's why."

choices.label: "I understand."
choices.reply: "I know you do," {who} says. "That's the worst of it."

choices.label: "Wait. Let me help you fight it."
choices.reply: "That's what it would say," {who} says. Not unkindly.
